DECLARE @LagerID INT = 29;
DECLARE @WarengruppeListe TABLE (kWarengruppe INT);
INSERT INTO @WarengruppeListe VALUES (1),(9);

SELECT
    a.cArtNr                           AS Artikelnummer,
    ab.cName                           AS Artikelname,
    l.fLagerbestand                    AS Lagerbestand,
	l.fInAuftraegen					   AS BestandInAufträgen,
    l.fVerfuegbar                      AS Verfuegbar,
    a.nMidestbestand                   AS Mindestbestand,
    COALESCE(l.fVerfuegbar,0) - COALESCE(a.nMidestbestand, a.nMidestbestand,0) AS PufferZumSoll
FROM dbo.tLagerbestand AS l
JOIN dbo.tArtikel AS a ON a.kArtikel = l.kArtikel
INNER JOIN tArtikelBeschreibung AS ab ON ab.kArtikel = a.kArtikel AND ab.kSprache = 1 AND ab.kPlattform = 1
JOIN dbo.tlagerbestandProLagerLagerartikel AS lb ON lb.kArtikel = a.kArtikel
WHERE lb.kWarenlager = @LagerID
  AND a.kWarengruppe IN (SELECT kWarengruppe FROM @WarengruppeListe)
  AND a.nIstVater = 0
  AND a.cArtNr NOT LIKE 'B2B%'
  AND a.cArtNr NOT LIKE '%-ME'
  AND a.cArtNr NOT LIKE '%- ME'
  AND a.cArtNr NOT LIKE '%BME'
  AND a.cArtNr NOT LIKE 'POPUP%'
  AND COALESCE(l.fVerfuegbar,0) - COALESCE(a.nMidestbestand, a.nMidestbestand,0) < 0
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.tArtikelAttribut AS aa
        INNER JOIN dbo.tArtikelAttributSprache AS aas ON aas.kArtikelAttribut = aa.kArtikelAttribut
        WHERE aa.kArtikel = a.kArtikel
          AND aa.kAttribut = 331
          AND aas.nWertInt = 1
      )
ORDER BY PufferZumSoll;
